title: Washington / Mapping
description: Two interfaces for exploring Washington’s landscape: geological layers and natural hazards, alongside lidar coverage, terrain, and elevation data.
note: Washington Department of Natural Resources · Explore either live portal below.

links.title: Washington Geologic Information Portal
links.description: Geology, natural hazards, and geoscience layers.

links.title: Washington Lidar Portal
links.description: Lidar coverage, terrain layers, and data downloads.

title: Block Factory
description: An interactive view of Ethereum’s public mempool and block activity. Pending transactions form a globe of points before flowing into confirmed blocks, revealing transaction order and fees.
note: Read-only Ethereum visualization · Live data with a recorded replay fallback.

title: Merced River
description: After Albert Bierstadt, 1866. Late light through a storm; the river holds the cliffs still while two canoes cross and horses graze the meadow.
controls: Drag to look · scroll to zoom · W A S D to walk

title: Isle of the Dead
description: After Arnold Böcklin, 1880. Evening on a still sea: the last light on the rock, the cypresses already dark, a boat crossing to the landing.
controls: Drag to look · scroll to zoom · W A S D to walk

title: Fog Hollow
description: After the three.js fog-scattering example. Dawn fog lies in the hollow; the low sun breaks through the firs and the far trees dissolve.
controls: Drag to look · W A S D to walk · Shift to hurry

title: Indigo Ridge
description: Blue hour on a grass ridge: a walker climbs past a lone tree as the light goes.
controls: Drag to orbit · right-drag to pan · scroll to zoom

title: Dents du Midi
description: After Gustave Courbet, 1877. A goatherd rests on the knoll above the lake while the herd grazes; cloud shadows cross the massif.
controls: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom

title: Gulf Stream Study
description: The sea of Winslow Homer’s Gulf Stream, 1899. Only the water: turquoise swell running before the trade wind, the sun showing through every crest.

title: Rigging Bench
description: Drop in a humanoid model and watch it move: bones are matched automatically and CC0 motion capture is retargeted onto it.
controls: Drag to orbit · drop a .glb, .fbx or .obj onto the bench
